rules: Terminal states (COMPLETED, FAILED, TIMED_OUT, CANCELLED) are immutable and cannot transition back to active.
User cancellation immediately sets abort_event and drops in-flight token buffers.
Cross-thread signal emission uses Qt queued connection mechanism to prevent race conditions.

verification_points.test: Brain abort generation halts in-flight loop
Session isolation prevents cross-session token bleeding
PDF worker cleanly transitions to CANCELLED upon midway abort
